title: Separate original WP11 input proof from current verification
objective: Implement separately reviewed PR086 portable historical WP11 input proof and distinct unapproved current technical/wrapper verification.
outcome: Historical WP11 approval remains bound to its exact original 154-file snapshot while actual current inputs receive separate, unapproved technical and wrapper checks. No current approval, combined acceptance, merge, or deployment is issued.
